title: Portable Container Restock Identity Policy
rules: A portable container restock requires an authoritative container instance, owner, restock key, canonical item, and target quantity.
Existing matching contents retain their runtime identities.
Only the deficit is created and repeated reconciliation at target is idempotent.
Projected stack maxima and portable-container capacity are enforced.
Existing quantities above target are never silently removed.
Scheduling remains owned by World Runtime, scripts, quests, or events.

bidirectional_relationships.container_to_contents: container instance -> restock key -> canonical item target
bidirectional_relationships.content_to_container: runtime item instance -> container location -> restock provenance
